items.title: 4.1.3.1 Infix, Postfix, and Prefix Notations; Converting an Infix Expression to Postfix (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of notations and conversion (PDF 97-98).

blocks.text: Maths aur computer science mein expressions (hisabi jumle) mukhtalif notations (likhne ke tareeqon) mein likhe ja sakte hain. Teen aham notations hain: infix, postfix aur prefix.

items: Infix notation: operator (jaise +, x) do operands (values, jaise A aur B) ke darmiyan hota hai. Hum aam hisab aur algebra isi tarah likhte hain. Misal: A + B ya (A + B) x C.
A + B mein operator + operands A aur B ke beech mein hai. Kaunsa kaam pehle ho, yeh dikhane ke liye parentheses (brackets) lagaye ja sakte hain.

Postfix notation (Reverse Polish Notation, RPN): operator operands ke baad aata hai. Is mein kaam ki tarteeb dikhane ke liye brackets ki zaroorat nahi. Misal: A + B postfix mein AB+ aur (A + B) x C postfix mein AB+C x.
AB+ mein pehle operands A aur B aate hain, phir operator +, yaani A aur B ko jorna hai. AB+C x mein pehle A aur B jorte hain, phir nateeje ko C se zarb (multiply) karte hain.
Prefix notation (Polish Notation): operator operands se pehle aata hai. Postfix ki tarah is mein bhi brackets ki zaroorat nahi. Misal: +AB ya +A x BC.
+AB mein + operands A aur B se pehle hai, yaani A aur B ko jorna hai. +A x BC mein pehle B aur C ki zarb hoti hai, phir nateeje mein A jorte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “In -\-AB” chhapa hai; yahan +AB hona chahiye (operator + operands A aur B se pehle).
Infix expression (jaise 3 + 4 * 5) ko postfix (jaise 3 4 5 * +) mein badalne se computer ke liye hisab aasan ho jata hai. Is kaam mein stack madad karta hai. Tareeqa yeh hai:

items: Khali stack aur khali output list se shuru karein.
Infix expression ko baen se daen (left to right) parhein.
Operand (number ya letter) mile to seedha output list mein likh dein.

Operator (+, -, *) mile to use stack par push karein. Lekin agar stack par pehle se barabar ya zyada priority (pehle hone ka haq) wala operator ho, to pehle use pop kar ke output mein likhein, phir naya operator push karein.
Left parenthesis ( mile to use stack par push karein.
Right parenthesis ) mile to stack se operators pop kar ke output mein likhte jayein jab tak ( na mil jaye. Phir ( ko stack se hata dein, magar output mein na likhein.

blocks.text: Poora expression parh lene ke baad stack mein bache saare operators pop kar ke output mein likh dein.

blocks.title: Misal:
blocks.problem: Infix expression 3 + 4 * 2 ko postfix mein badlein.
steps: Khali stack aur khali output list se shuru karein.
* parha: * ki priority + se zyada hai, is liye push kiya: [+, *].
Aakhir mein stack ke saare operators pop kiye (pehle *, phir +): [3, 4, 2, *, +].

blocks.prompt: Infix se postfix banate waqt stack kis cheez ko sambhalta hai (MCQ 4)?
blocks.explanation: (d) Both b and c: operators ki priority aur parentheses dono.

blocks.prompt: Long question 4: (5 + 2) * (3 - 1) ko stack se postfix mein badlein, aur har token ke baad stack aur output dikhayein.
blocks.explanation:
( : stack [(], output []
5 : stack [(], output [5]
+ : stack [(, +], output [5]
2 : stack [(, +], output [5, 2]
) : + pop; stack [], output [5, 2, +]
* : stack [*], output [5, 2, +]
( : stack [*, (], output [5, 2, +]
3 : stack [*, (], output [5, 2, +, 3]
- : stack [*, (, -], output [5, 2, +, 3]
1 : stack [*, (, -], output [5, 2, +, 3, 1]
) : - pop; stack [*], output [5, 2, +, 3, 1, -]
Aakhir: * pop; postfix 5 2 + 3 1 - *, jis ki value 7 x 2 = 14 hai.

items: Infix A + B, postfix A B +, prefix + A B.
Infix se postfix: operand output mein, operators aur ( stack par; 3 + 4 * 2 ka postfix 3 4 2 * + hai.
